data.name: Memory_Journal_Explanation
data.value: The journal of the project (.agentstudio/bitacora/) is memory too. What Agent Studio notes in its runs leaves a receipt in the log. With that receipt it is checked, and it is trusted. The rest waits in quarantine. That is your development notes, what comes with the repository and what was noted before receipts. No agent receives it until you accept it: entry by entry, by days or for the whole project. Every decision stays in the log and you can withdraw it. The judge never receives the journal.

data.name: Memory_Settings_Explanation
data.value: When it plans, the orchestrator can look up what happened on earlier days of the project: decisions, known errors and the trusted journal. It only reads, it does not leave your computer and it spends no extra usage limit. It only works with Claude Code and if the orchestrator receives the project memory in the template. If you turn it off, it plans as before, and the proposal says so.
